# Independent array and exception formals

An owned provider keeps T extends Object in one array input and its array result,
while a distinct X extends Throwable owns Supplier<X> and the throws slot. Four
frozen callers compare 96 cases twice for source and SDK providers, including
opaque and aliased arrays, lazy or null suppliers, exact checked/runtime/Error
identity, original input casts, array store failures and later component casts.
Every recovered unit and original metadata entry is compiled and audited. Six
wrong programs and six Code-preserving Signature controls test observation and
scope. Only owned in-memory code executes.
